The lichened caverns below the stoke hole, once giving berth to hills of cane husk--fodder for the zooming fire--fertilized beds of purple beans.
Try to break a little more land every year; sod corn is good for fodder.
"Oh! she's up to strange tricks, always ... and none of her ways are those of honest farmers--no fennel over our doors, unholy fodder in our granary ... and in her heart, thoughts as unholy.
‘His sod corn will be good for fodder this winter,’ said grandfather encouragingly.

And then--even if she should have eaten what you fear she has--I shall be much surprised if a Honeysuckle isn't able with time and care to throw off all effects of that foul fodder and grow up into as sensible a woman--as her mother."
